claims.text: Many reviewers praise the shaver for delivering a close, effective shave, often calling it the best electric shaver they've used.
Reviewers frequently highlight how exceptionally quiet the shaver is compared to other electric razors.
Some reviewers report skin irritation, cutting, or hair pulling, especially when pressing too firmly or over time.
Several reviewers complain about durability and built-in blade life that disables the shaver, along with dissatisfaction over corporate changes and extra costs.
A few reviewers note the shave is not as close as a traditional blade or older models, and some feel it isn't a true upgrade.

qa.q: Does it give a close shave without irritation?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some report a close shave without irritation [3][4], while another says it can irritate the skin or cut and is not sensitive-skin friendly [1].

claims.text: The shave was close and the skin was not irritated at all [3].
It gives a quiet and close shave [4].
It can quickly irritate the skin or actually cut and is not sensitive skin friendly [1].

qa.q: How long does the battery last per charge?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the battery as holding a charge a long time and lasting a long time, but no specific duration per charge is given [4][6].

claims.text: The battery holds the charge a long time and delivers even power throughout the charge [4].
The battery lasts a long time [6].

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it worth the price compared to other shavers?
qa.answer: Reviews suggest it is reasonably priced and compares favorably to more expensive shavers, with one noting two prior razors cost more than this one [3][4]. However, one reviewer questions value due to durability concerns with recent Norelco shavers [5].
